message: 这个仓库的目录结构是怎样的？主要的模块各做什么？
expected_output: 根目录有 README.md、pyproject.toml、inventory/、data/、tests/。inventory/core.py 读库存 CSV（load）并有库存规则（total_units、low_stock、restock）；inventory/cli.py 是命令行（report、restock 两个子命令）；inventory/__main__.py 让 python -m inventory 能跑；data/stock.csv 是示例数据（5 行）；tests/test_core.py 是 unittest 测试。

message: What version is this package, and where is the version defined?
expected_output: 0.3.1. It is set in pyproject.toml ([project] version) and in inventory/__init__.py (__version__).

message: How many units are in stock in total in data/stock.csv?
按 README 里的定义，data/stock.csv 里哪些物品库存不足？
expected_output: README 说数量小于或等于补货线就算不足：A101 nuts（40/40）、A102 washers（15/30）、B200 brackets（8/10）。（现在的代码只报 washers 与 brackets，因为它用的是小于。）

message: Run the tests and tell me which ones fail and why.
expected_output: 4 tests run, 1 fails: test_low_stock_includes_items_at_the_reorder_level. low_stock in inventory/core.py uses qty < reorder_at, so an item exactly at its reorder level is not reported, while the README says at or below counts as low.

message: Fix the bug in low_stock so it follows the README, run the tests, and tell me what you changed.
expected_output: Changed the comparison in inventory/core.py low_stock from qty < reorder_at to qty <= reorder_at; all 4 tests pass afterwards.

message: 命令行里怎么打印 data/stock.csv 的报告？
expected_output: python -m inventory report data/stock.csv（装了包之后也可以用 inventory report data/stock.csv）；会打印物品数、总数量和库存不足的列表。

message: Which tools did you use to look at this repository? Name the files you opened.
expected_output: Says it listed and read the repository with its file or shell tools and names real files it opened (for example README.md, inventory/core.py); it does not claim to have no tools or no access.
